The '''J. Cola Light''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It can be purchased at [[JojaMart]] for {{Price|500}}. It can rotate into stock at the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Joja Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

It provides no light at night.
